purpose.summary: This is a batch COBOL program (ORCR0030) belonging to the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt software system used in Japan. It appears to aggregate and calculate point/score totals by medical treatment category (診療区分別点数集計) for insurance claim receipts (レセプト). The program handles complex Japanese national health insurance billing rules including co-payment amounts, prescription fees, examination counts, and various special treatment categories.

The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical billing system. The absence of COMP-3 is somewhat unusual for a billing program but not disqualifying.
